newsitem.title: UK: BG unlikely to fight windfall tax-paper.
newsitem.headline: BG unlikely to fight windfall tax-paper.

text.p: BG Plc, the pipeline operation demerged from British Gas, was studying the windfall tax, but signalled it would not take action against the government, the Financial Times said on Friday.
The paper quoted a BG spokesman as saying, "We are not predisposed to challenge a tax for which the government has a popular mandate."
It said the US owners of the regional electricity company also appeared to have decided to pay.
The Financial Times said the distribution of the 5.2 billion stg windfall tax made it unlikely that UK privatised utilities would take legal action. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
